title: RabbitMQ management API is reachable without signing in
summary: The RabbitMQ management API answers unauthenticated, which exposes queues, users and virtual hosts.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("rabbitmq_version") or body_contains("management_version")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on the management plugin.
